newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hypo-Bank, BHF to lead-manage Pro Sieben flotation.
newsitem.headline: Hypo-Bank, BHF to lead-manage Pro Sieben flotation.

text.p: Bayerische Hypotheken- und Wechsel-Bank AG and BHF-Bank AG will lead the bank consortium for the planned flotation of private television channel Pro Sieben Media AG, Pro Sieben said on Monday.
Salomon Brothers is co lead-manager. The consortium also includes CS First Boston, Commerzbank AG, DG Bank and Goldman Sachs.
Pro Sieben said on Sunday it would issue non-voting preference shares in July.
Pro Sieben will become the first German television station with a stock market listing.
